title: Smoky Mackerel Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew originating from Tunisia, typically made with mackerel, olives, and spices. This version incorporates smoky flavors and infused ingredients.

ingredients.name: mackerel fillets
ingredients.notes: any firm white fish can be used as substitute

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mackerel fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned.
Add the chopped parsley, lemon juice, smoked paprika, and Tunisian spice blend.
Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
